alerts.reason: Weis’s year-over-year net sales growth slowed from 13.66% in December to 2.08% in March. Record E attributes part of the sales lift to closures of other food sources and to stimulus payments. I expect growth to stay above -5.00% in the intervening quarter, then reach -5.00% or lower in the quarter beginning June 27 as Weis compares against sales lifted by those temporary factors.
